notes: «قال يحيى قال سفيان لا أدري من قول من هو» is Sufyan's remark, passed on by Yahya: a second statement with its own transmission; the rules do not settle whether it is a second route, so it is left out of the routes

fixes.reason: K6I's third link (Yahya b. Abi Kathir) is not written after «عن الزهري»; the text names Sufyan then al-Zuhri, and the K6I name likely comes from the remark «قال يحيى»
